summary: Negative years were padded before their minus sign: year -1 displayed as 00-1 instead of -0001. The fix writes the sign separately, then pads the unsigned magnitude using itoa. The existing display test in tests/date.rs gains the detecting -0001 assertion. Blocked: restoring the historical behavior requires coordinated reversals in multiple files because format_value was replaced by format_number. The schema permits only one region in one file. Reversing only the sign block would instead drop negative signs, introducing behavior different from the historical bug; restoring its original formatting call alone would reference the removed helper. No builds or tests were run.
